pr.title: Fix search treating % and _ as wildcards

findings.what: I could not run the suite. `npm test` fails with 'vitest: not found' because dependencies aren't installed here. So I did not confirm that the new tests pass or that inserted rows are isolated between tests.
findings.fix: Run `npm install && npm test` in CI before merging.

lenses.note: This is a small bug fix with one obvious design: escape the LIKE wildcards. The PR's words match the diff.
There is no spec file in this change.
The new tests cover %, _ and \ against the real D1 binding. They would fail without the ESCAPE clause. I could not run them.
README mentions `?q=` searching titles only, which is still accurate. No doc describes the old wildcard behaviour.
Escaping runs on the backslash, % and _ in one regex pass. The ESCAPE clause is `'\\'` in JS, which gives the SQL `'\'`. The value is bound as a parameter.
The query stays parameterized. The search term is escaped for the HTML output. No injection path was introduced.
The diff touches no UI files. It changes the query in src/index.js and adds tests.
The diff touches no UI files.
The title is under 72 characters. The claims match the diff: ESCAPE added, the three characters escaped, and the new test. No tests were deleted or loosened.
